description: Source code for HoverHUDController, a SwiftUI and AppKit based class managing a hover-only HUD panel for macOS menu bar item. Implements UI presentation, hover detection, and interaction logic for a floating chat HUD.

classes.name: HoverHUDController
classes.description: Main controller managing the hover HUD panel, its presentation, dismissal, and UI interactions.

methods.name: setSuppressed
methods.description: Sets the suppressed state of the HUD, cancels show tasks, and dismisses if suppressed.

methods.name: statusItemHoverChanged
methods.description: Handles hover state changes over the status item, schedules display or dismissal of HUD.

methods.name: panelHoverChanged
methods.description: Handles hover state changes over the panel itself, affects dismissal scheduling.

methods.name: openChat
methods.description: Opens the chat panel. Dismisses the HUD and triggers toggle for chat panel via WebChatManager.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the HUD with optional reason, cancels tasks, and animates hiding.

methods.name: scheduleDismiss
methods.description: Schedules the dismissal of HUD after a delay unless still hovered.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Ensures window exists, updates view, and presents the HUD at calculated target frame.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Creates the overlay panel window if not already created.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Calculates the frame where the HUD should appear, anchored relative to the status item or anchor provider.

methods.name: updateWindowFrame
methods.description: Updates window position and size with optional animation.

methods.name: installDismissMonitor
methods.description: Sets up global mouse event monitor to detect clicks outside the HUD to dismiss.

methods.name: removeDismissMonitor
methods.description: Removes previously installed global monitor for dismissing.
